author: hasl
body:
Age: 14

Timezone: BST

Do you have Teamspeak? Yep

Do you have Discord? Yep

Do you have access to a recording software? Yep



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?

Many months as both senior and just moderator on Avicus.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?

My history. I've had several bad times throughout my 3+ years here. Many of the players who were here when I first joined have moved on ,but many members in the staff team hopefully know I exist, for better or worse.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

Experience, determination and passion are key attributes for a leader. Without all three I don't believe you can be an effective leader. I'm not looking to be a leader, I'm just applying to help people as a hobby. If I had to step up and take charge I happily would try my best.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

Experience is something I definitely have, you can't just rack up 3+ years of being in a community over night.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

You've got to know your audience and be approachable if you wan't to have any chance of successfully interacting with your player base. I may not be as familiar with the community as you would like, but I am certainly approachable.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

When you are a moderator you are representing the staff team and any new players online who see an abusive or lazy staff member won't be here for much longer.


You could try to be a perfect moderator, but everyone is human and makes mistakes. You just have to do your best to fix it and move on. Being a robot is the worse thing possible. You just need to use common sense most of the time.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

Definitely approach any online senior staff member about this issue and explain as best I could what is going on. Then gather evidence by going on my second account (not breaking rules eg. hacking) and attempting to be banned by said moderator, if I appealed and they had no evidence then that would be great evidence to pass on to the senior staff.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

Everyone is allowed their own opinion. I recall last year the issue with Zac, who would always find loopholes in the rules on TeamSpeak and it took up so much time because we couldn't have a channel where "anything goes" literally meant that.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

Just privately message the team mate reminding them that it's not allowed. If it's a repeating offence then I would definitely report it to the senior staff because the leaked images may concern the non staff players in the team.

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

Clearly this is certain abuse of power and should definitely receive a punishment. I would immediately start my screen recording program up for evidence and then contact any other senior staff members that are online to deal with this situation.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER


Why do you want to be a moderator?

I've been gone a while and to be honest I've really missed it. I want to be apart of the time and put my spare time into helping this server again.

What does Avicus mean to you?

I've had over three years of memories here and have made so many friends here. It was a place where I could chat with so many different people and play the game I love.


Anything specific the staff team could do better?

The forum could have a lot more of staff lead discussion posts and community events.

Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

It's the only server I've connected with and have so much time played on.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?
